blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Nine years after her son was gunned down in the streets of Tondo, a grieving mother is taking her fight for justice and accountability to the public. Nanette Castillo will take the stand this Friday, October 23, during the Truth Commission’s 5th Public Truth-Telling Session held at Adamson University in Manila. In an emailed advisory on Tuesday, the commission said that Castillo is set to recount the October 2017 killing of her 32-year-old son, Aldrin, a welder who only went to Tondo to repair his sister’s air conditioner.
